claim: RDFR-CI combines E, D, A, F and C with the stated default illustrative weights.
notes: Weights are governance parameters, not universal constants.

claim: Authority bands use half-open thresholds at 0.20, 0.35, 0.50 and 0.65.
notes: Boundary unit tests cover exact thresholds.

claim: The consequence term creates a lower bound R_min = w_C*C and bounded automation is unreachable at C >= 0.80 when w_C=0.25.
notes: Derived analytically and plotted.

claim: Failed gates can maintain or reduce but never increase authority.
notes: Software uses restriction ranks; max rank is equivalent to manuscript min on permissiveness.

claim: Child agents cannot inherit more authority than parent, scope and applicable gates permit.
notes: Three synthetic demonstrations plus JSONL witness log.

claim: Uncertainty near score boundaries can change the resulting authority band.
notes: sigma=0.05 synthetic elicitation uncertainty.

claim: The paper's six showcase point scores are reproducible from the stated E,D,A,F,C inputs.
notes: Not measured sector risk.

claim: The 30-scenario library spans eighteen sectors.
notes: Synthetic scenario library.

claim: Twenty-one of thirty scenarios change provisional state under at least one tested alternative aggregation.
notes: Catalog is versioned to reproduce this manuscript analysis.

claim: The score is the binding constraint in roughly two thirds of the 30 scenarios and a gate in the remaining third.
notes: Configured illustrative scenario outcomes: 20 score, 10 gate.

claim: G_A is the most frequent binding gate in the configured scenario library.
notes: Synthetic governance configuration.

claim: Rare safety-loss events can contribute less than 8% of expected loss while becoming the largest upper-tail channel.
notes: Synthetic Monte Carlo demonstration, not sector loss data.

claim: Global-F1 and authority-aware threshold selection can prefer different operating points.
notes: Synthetic detector scores.

claim: The manuscript's reported Table 7 operating points are preserved as the stated synthetic configuration.
notes: Not claimed to come from SWaT.

claim: High numeric inter-rater agreement can coexist with discrete state disagreement near thresholds.
notes: Synthetic methodological demonstration.

claim: SWaT can test the detector-to-authority link D(phi) -> R_CI -> provisional authority.
notes: Execution requires authorized official SWaT files.

claim: No SWaT-derived numerical performance is claimed in this repository release.
notes: Runner exits explicitly when files are absent.

claim: Water-showcase mapping is R_CI(tau)=0.430+0.20*D(tau) with E=0.55,A=0.30,F=0.25,C=0.90.
notes: Analytical mapping only; D is empirical only after authorized run.

claim: F = 1 - Q_F where Q_F covers EC,PC,TI,CC,RW.
notes: Independent witnessing is explicit.

claim: RDFR-CI can complement NIST/EU/IEC governance but is not a compliance certification method.
notes: Normative/legal applicability remains organization-specific.

claim: Full empirical validation of F requires organizational audit records or purpose-built testbeds.
notes: No public dataset is asserted here to supply these fields.

claim: Broader multi-testbed validation beyond SWaT remains future work.
notes: HAI/power-system extensions are not executed in v1.0.0.
